title: Increment after a prefix of true bits
statement: For every natural number $n$ and Boolean word $w$, incrementing the concatenation of $n$ true bits with $w$ gives the result of incrementing $w$ and, when that result exists, prefixing it with $n$ false bits. If incrementing $w$ overflows, both sides are undefined.
